# Neon (Databricks) — Neon and Databricks Startup Program

Two tiers of credits valid 12 months: up to $1,000 in Neon credits for self-funded startups with under $1M raised, and up to $200K in Neon and Databricks credits for VC-backed startups with at least $1M raised or recognized-accelerator participants.

| **When it ends** | Page states: "When your credits are used up or reach their 12-month expiration, your account continues on your selected plan and you're billed normally for usage beyond the credit." |

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Self-funded | $1,000 | Up to $1,000 in Neon credits | No partner needed |
| Venture-backed | $200,000 | Up to $200K in Neon and Databricks credits | A partner improves the offer, but is not required |

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

Two distinct tiers with opposite funding directions: the self-funded tier requires "Less than $1M in funding" (a ceiling), the venture-backed tier requires "at least $1M in funding" (a floor) or participation in a recognized accelerator such as Y Combinator. Top-level funding fields are left null because the two tiers point in opposite directions; see tiers[]. The page states existing customers can apply and that approved applicants receive credits on their current account without migration, so new_customer_only is recorded as false. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
